name: Baselode Energy Corp.
content: Baselode Energy Corp. is a Canadian uranium exploration company focused on discovering high-grade, basement-hosted uranium deposits in the Athabasca Basin area of northern Saskatchewan. The company utilizes innovative geophysical techniques and a 'Basement-First' exploration strategy to identify shallow, high-grade targets outside of the traditional sandstone-hosted models. Baselode's primary projects include the Hook, Catharsis, and Shadow projects, with the ACKIO discovery on the Hook project representing a significant near-surface uranium find. The company is committed to efficient exploration and creating shareholder value through discovery in one of the world's premier uranium jurisdictions.

Officers

James SykesJune 2020

Chief Executive Officer and President

Mr. Sykes has over 15 years of uranium exploration and discovery experience in the Athabasca Basin. He was instrumental in the discovery of the Roughrider, Arrow, and Triple R deposits. He previously served as Vice President, Exploration for Appia Energy Corp. and has held roles with NexGen Energy, Hathor Exploration, and Rio Tinto.

Kevin MaJune 2020

Chief Financial Officer

Mr. Ma is a senior financial professional with over 15 years of experience in corporate finance, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance. He is a Chartered Professional Accountant and has served as CFO for several publicly traded resource companies.

Cameron McKaySeptember 2021

Vice President, Exploration

Mr. McKay is a professional geologist with over 10 years of experience in uranium exploration. He has been involved in various stages of exploration from grassroots to resource definition in the Athabasca Basin.
